description.value: Bellaggio Café is an owner-operated Italian restaurant in the heart of downtown Vancouver, steps from the Vancouver Art Gallery and Pacific Centre. Owners Barbara and Emil offer an authentic Italian menu featuring wood stone oven pizza, with full bar service and the ability to host groups up to 120 guests on the patio or indoors. Its central Hornby Street location makes it a natural stop on any urban cycling route through the downtown core.
